change.summary: Hide optional source-mod metadata without ever removing an item's title line

modifiers.before: Every tooltip component equal to any installed mod display name was removed, including line zero when an item and its mod shared a name
modifiers.after: Only metadata components after the immutable title line are eligible for source-mod filtering
modifiers.notes: Item Magnet keeps its native title even though both the item and mod display names are Item Magnet

rationale.purpose: Prevent creative inventory tooltip rendering from receiving an empty list
rationale.decision_source: User crash report and exact client crash evidence on 2026-10-31
rationale.user_requested: Fix Minecraft crashing when attempting to take Item Magnet
rationale.codex_choices: Make line zero structurally ineligible for mod-name removal instead of special-casing Item Magnet

introduced.summary: Restrict source-mod filtering to tooltip metadata after the title

history.summary: Keep every item title while retaining the user's hidden source-mod preference

relations: Native item title -> preserved line zero -> non-empty creative tooltip
Source-mod metadata after title -> existing optional filter
notes: No item acquisition, inventory, magnet behavior or server authority changes
